description: This file contains partial class definitions, extensions, and storage options related to Orleans Transactions with Azure Storage, including configuration options, validators, and storage factory implementations.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Options for Azure Storage policies such as timeouts and retries.

classes.description: Factory for creating Azure Table transactional state storage instances.
